name: Tennessee Chair Company
old_description: Tennessee Chair Company, which began in 1979, specializes in quality hardwood furniture. Our reputation throughout the southeast has been built around the comfort of our hand-made rocking chairs. We offer rockers in many different styles for not only adults but for children as well. While most of our chairs are constructed from white ash, one can choose to have their chair built from black walnut, red oak, wild cherry, poplar, or wormy maple.
about:
Tennessee Chair Company was founded in 1979 in Readyville, Tennessee, by Tim and Beth Watts. Tim began selling hardwood porch furniture at events and fairs across the Southeast in 1977, and after over 30 years on the road, the company's primary account became the Tennessee Farmer's Cooperative.

The company manufactures handmade hardwood furniture, specializing in rocking chairs for adults and children, as well as dining sets, hutches, and barstools. Its reputation throughout the Southeast has been built around the comfort of its hand-made rocking chairs. Most pieces are built from white ash, with options for black walnut, red oak, wild cherry, poplar, and wormy maple. The Readyville location provides access to native hardwoods ideal for furniture construction.

The company serves residential customers and retail partners across the Southeast, with the Tennessee Farmer's Cooperative as its main account. Products are sold through events, fairs, and direct sales.

The company emphasizes comfort, quality, and lumbar support, attributing success to craftsmanship and customer relationships. They offer personalization options for each piece, and the founders credit their success to their faith and the free enterprise system.
